_note: Private gateway (this worktree, Claude as the model, REGISTRY_SEED_ENV=false, AVATAR_PREWARM_ON_CASE_START=true) and Lambda gpu_1x_a100_sxm4 (40 GB) workers it launched in us-east-1, 2026-10-22. Browser: Playwright Chromium with no proxy; TURN over TCP through scripts/turn_ws_tunnel.py (TURN over TLS on 443 could not be carried from this sandbox: Chromium's WebRTC resolves the TURN name with its own DNS, ignoring /etc/hosts and --host-resolver-rules, and the sandbox re-terminates outbound TLS). Speech start = question sent to first audible patient sample in the page. Lip lag: positive = mouth after the voice; offsets with a score under 0.3 are not counted. Sender skew = video minus audio send-time offset measured by the runner per encoded frame.
tr-a100-baseline: prod code (454192b) on A100 40 GB with vLLM (0.45) and the image edits in model offload; fixed 160 ms video delay and the per-line closed loop; voice click at case open
tr-a100-nollm-autosync: vLLM off (Claude serves the text), image edits in gpu mode, auto sync from the sender clock plus the receive-side reading in the delay (later switched off), ICE settle; no hold yet: a look prepared during line 1 stalled the runner
